B31.name: 银鮈
B31.form: an elongated slender body, a complete lateral line with 38 to 41 scales
B31.fins: a dorsal fin with 7 branched rays, an anal fin with 6 branched rays, pectoral fins with one spine and 14 to 16 rays, pelvic fins with one spine and 7 to 8 rays
B31.markings: a longitudinal band running above the lateral line along the flank

B32.name: 短颌鲚
B32.form: an elongated laterally compressed body tapering to a pointed tail, the upper jaw shorter than the lower, a large mouth, a belly with a row of scutes
B32.fins: a long anal fin joined to the tail fin, a forked tail fin

A01.name: 沙丁鱼
A01.form: an elongated body, the lower jaw slightly longer than the upper, inconspicuous teeth

A02.name: 竹荚鱼
A02.form: a conical head, large eyes with a well-developed adipose eyelid covering the front and rear of the eye, the eye diameter greater than the snout length, a large oblique mouth, a single row of fine teeth in each jaw
A02.markings: a spot at the rear edge of the gill cover

A03.name: 黑鲷
A03.form: an elongated oval laterally compressed body, weakly ctenoid scales, a pointed blunt front, a large head with a small mouth, a rounded convex interorbital space, the upper and lower jaws equal in length
A03.markings: an irregular blotch at the origin of the lateral line, transverse bands along the flanks that vary with age
A03.colour: 体背部灰黑色，腹部色淡具银光

A04.name: 黄鳍鲷
A04.form: an elongated oval laterally compressed body, a narrow back, a blunt rounded belly with slight curvature
A04.markings: several longitudinal lines along the flanks following the scale rows
A04.colour: 体色青灰带黄，背鳍、臀鳍的一小部分及尾鳍边缘灰黑色，腹鳍、臀鳍的大部及尾鳍下叶为黄

A05.name: 鲻鱼
A05.form: rather large eyes with a well-developed adipose eyelid, an inferior small mouth with a herringbone-shaped cleft, tiny villiform teeth, cycloid scales covering the whole body, no lateral line
A05.fins: pectoral fins without an axillary scale, two dorsal fins, an anal fin with 8 rays, a deeply forked tail fin
A05.markings: a blotch at the base of the pectoral fin
A05.colour: 体、背、头部呈青灰色，腹部呈白色

A06.name: 石斑鱼
A06.form: a stout oval body, a large head, a large mouth with the lower jaw protruding, ctenoid scales
A06.fins: a dorsal fin with spines and soft rays, a rounded tail fin
A06.markings: spots and blotches along the flanks
A06.colour: 体色随种类与栖息环境变化，常有不规则斑点和斑块
